scoring_justification: Paper's main result is the relative ordering of energy gaps among the four Zr-substitution cases; exact absolute values are strongly method-dependent and not scored. Therefore we adopt structural scoring of the trend.

outputs.description: HOMO-LUMO energy gaps for the four cluster models and the claimed relative ordering. The checker validates the ordering as described in the paper; exact numerical values are not compared due to method differences.

output_contract.notes: Only the relative ordering of the HOMO-LUMO gaps is scored; the exact gap magnitude is free to vary with the chosen DFT implementation. The net-charge and overlap-population analyses are omitted as they are not central to the fatigue prediction claim and are strongly method-dependent.

hidden_assets.purpose: gold ordering relations for HOMO-LUMO gap trend
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Figure 5 and conclusion: no_substitution < upper_Zr < lower_Zr < both, and lower_Zr > upper_Zr
hidden_assets.generation_method: extracted from the published trend of the paper
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: derived from the paper's reported claim; these relations are the core reproduction target
